newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY TO PLAY N.IRELAND IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY TO PLAY N.IRELAND IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: Cesare Maldini will face his first test as coach of Italy in a friendly against Northern Ireland on January 22, the Italian soccer federation said on Saturday.
The match will kick off in the Sicilian capital of Palermo at 1930 GMT, the federation said in a statement.

Maldini, who won the last three European titles as coach of Italy's under-21 squad, took over the senior side last Sunday after Arrigo Sacchi resigned to return as trainer of AC Milan, his former club.
The friendly will be Maldini's only warm-up before a key World Cup qualifier against England at Wembley on February 12.
